title: BotSpy: unified coding-agent session history module
description: Product = the module itself: one adapter per coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok Bot, Antigravity, more later), one standard normalized schema, and a unified agent-session history. Metrics such as the thanks-vs-F-bombs meter and local sentiment analysis are example consumers (examples/ or an optional botspy[metrics] extra), never core work and never core dependencies. BotSpy is a behavior-driven specification project: the Gherkin specs under features/ are the backbone and the true source; every feature-area epic starts with spec-writing tasks and implementation tasks are blocked-by them. Reference for real on-disk formats (read-only): ~/Projects/DataParade-io/scanner-sentiment/src/sentiment/adapters - note the prototype extracted human messages only; BotSpy needs ALL message and part types.
right_now_summary: The team is building adapters, schemas, specs, tests, exports, and docs for unified coding-agent history.
